notes.title: Multilingual update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, I have just released another small update to Chapter 10. I said small, but it was actually a lot of work 😅 There are two major changes:[/p][p][/p][p]1) I made a lot of text fixes to the English version of the game. [b]MagicMan753[/b] collected hundreds of fixes and improvements, for which I am eternally grateful ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]2) I added translations in nine languages:[/p][list][*][p]German (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]French (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]Italian (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese (Brazil) (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]Czech[/p][/*][*][p] Polish (AI)[/p][/*][*][p]Turkish (AI)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Most of these were created using AI. Let me explain. I was always a firm believer in manual translations and disliked machine translations. However, two things have recently changed my mind. Firstly, several people told me independently that any translation is better than no translation if you don't understand English well enough to enjoy the game. Secondly, advances in AI have made it possible to create translations that take larger contexts into account, yielding much better results than "old school" machine translators.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, AI translation is more flexible, because I can e.g. translate a new chapter in a matter of hours. And last but not least, it's significantly less expensive.[/p][p][/p][p]That said, the result is not perfect. I'm well aware of that. There are inconsistencies, and some of the translations will undoubtedly sound strange to a native speaker. I consider this an experiment. If you test any of the translations, please let me know what you think. I'm curious to hear your reactions.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you! Have fun and enjoy your summer![/p]

notes.title: Chapter 10 Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I know you are eagerly awaiting the release of Chapter 10. And while it's getting closer every day, it's still far from ready. I've been struggling a bit with some technical and external issues, but don't worry, the next chapter is coming. You can see some previews of what is to come below.

In the meantime, I have released a small update to the current version of the game. The update fixes some minor issues (some images in the gallery were never unlocked) and adds a new "feature": the game now displays a detailed portrait of the key characters when you first meet them and at other key moments in the game.

notes.title: A small update to Chapter 9
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I have released a small update to Chapter 9 to address some issues and concerns. Thank you all for your reports/suggestions.

List of changes:
[list]
[*]Changed the tattoo scene to make it feel less rushed and less forced
[*]Added a new conclusion to the dinner scene for gentle Kalie
[*]Added a new Stats screen showing Kalie's and the protagonist's current state of mind (accessible via the Stats link at the bottom of the screen)
[*]Fixed several missing captions, sound effects and decals
[*]Balanced the number of gentle/evil points Kalie can get over the course of the game
[/list]

notes.title: Sneak preview of chapter 7 and more
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you're all doing well in 2024. I'm here with some information about the development of Gynocracy.


[h1]Chapter 7 Progress Report[/h1]
The development of Chapter 7 is progressing nicely. Here are some previews (warning, mild spoilers ahead):

Our protagonist visits the historical part of Valasca City, where he meets The Brats™.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328555/0827bbdfe12dfc740ed15b04cfa85d7fc10ff275.jpg[/img]

Danielle tells the protagonist a medieval legend. It's kind of a story-within-a-story where we get to see our familiar characters in different roles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328555/0d93002e21226f1b4feb62f8e464c10aa53c5fe3.jpg[/img]

Kalie finally appears in the latex outfit you may have seen in the promotional material.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328555/17d1c26728d5e2eeb1234a493277794c89e7db9b.png[/img]


[h1]Steam Deck Verified[/h1]
I can see from the Steam stats that some of you are playing Gynocracy on Steam Deck. At the end of last year, I did some work to make the portable experience as seamless as possible. And now I'm happy to announce that the game is officially Steam Deck Verified by Valve.


[h1]In closing[/h1]
And as always - if you like the game and haven't rated it yet, well, you know what to do :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328555/0130ae8112829a532ed16da63679006a19f08b0e.jpg[/img]

tags.feature: And now I'm happy to announce that the game is officially Steam Deck Verified by Valve.

notes.title: Community Items now available + Chapter 5 previews
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm here with some news.

[h1]Community Items now available[/h1]

A full set of community items is now available for the game! I hope you like them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328555/cdbe48ba7c3f65166ada3efa17537d2f764e5cfb.png[/img]


[h1]Chapter 5 previews[/h1]

[i](warning, mild spoilers ahead)[/i]

[b]Chapter 5: Starstruck[/b] is slowly nearing completion. It should be available sometime in November.
The chapter will consist of three main parts:

First, our protagonist will meet a movie star - Ava Crowley - a versatile actress who excels in both high-budget action films and indie productions, captivating audiences with her talent and emotional depth. You saw a glimpse of Ava's performance in Chapter 4. But in Chapter 5, you'll get a chance to meet her in person.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328555/9c9d3fc8ed6d3395c5fc091d6e6bf34c26d6e3e8.png[/img]

Second, Kalie will receive a dinner invitation from Dr. Clare. Clare will introduce our heroes to her fiancé and things will take an unexpected turn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328555/d5aa515ba59c3aad86e6ae636a1ac13a5f9d4050.png[/img]

Finally, Barbie will invite herself to the protagonist's house and she will throw a party. A Barbie kind of party...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328555/653f4fd224cf291d5fb770b7f446e1d266f45051.png[/img]

Thank you for your support, take care!

tags.feature: A full set of community items is now available for the game!
